value.rationale: A published theorem leaves the exact finite-sample optimal design unknown for odd numbers of raw oracle calls. The theorem resolves the full all-stencil, all-odd linear allocation problem and classifies every attaining design; it proves the third call lowers risk by approximately 17.45% compared with discarding it. The parity penalty becomes small for large n and the contribution is deliberately limited to the natural exact integer-budget problem.
